text:
Anika Rao: Heads-up: Finance + Product are launching a 4-week pilot called "Burst Amnesty" to reduce one-off invoice noise from short, high-traffic launches. This is a billing-side reconciliation credit, not a change to rate limits. :loudspeaker:

Victor Holt: Clarify: who gets credits and how big?

Anika Rao: Eligibility: hosted API customers on Standard+ with fewer than 3 spike windows in the billing period. Credits cap at a small percentage of monthly baseline (varies by tier). We label the invoice line `burst_amnesty_credit` so it's transparent.

Jared Lin: Will this affect Dedicated/Private customers or committed capacity?

Anika Rao: No impact on Reserved/Dedicated contracts. Private deployments are out. This only adjusts hosted invoices post-hoc.

Victor Holt: Ops concern: don't want to hide sustained capacity issues.

Anika Rao: Agreed. The pilot will skip customers flagged by our anomaly detector (sustained >24h, repeated region patterns). We'll add a telemetry tag for waived tokens so SRE can filter while debugging.

Jared Lin: Timeline and comms?

Anika Rao: Pilot starts 1860600000 (next Monday) for 28 days. We'll email eligible customers 72h in advance and add an opt-out link. Finance will include sample invoice snippets in the billing docs.

Billing Bot: Logged: Burst Amnesty pilot | start=1860600000 | duration=28d | doc=https://internal.redwood/billing/burst-amnesty-pilot. Weekly metric posts enabled. :robot_face:

Anika Rao: Action items: Victor -> add telemetry tag `burst_amnesty_waived`; Jared -> update billing UI preview to show provisional credit; Finance -> publish FAQ + invoice examples. I'll circle back with exact thresholds by EOD. :memo:
